title: ticket_fix_verification_input/v1
description: The step input that the host writes to .baltor/step/input.json before launch. Every path is relative to the workspace root, which is the top folder of the git worktree. The step reads this file and never edits it; every evidence file records its sha256.

base_revision.description: The commit the night started from for this ticket. HEAD must still be this commit.

reproduction_test_sha256.description: The digest the reproduction step recorded for the test file.

timeout_seconds.description: The limit for each of the two test commands.

allowed_path_prefixes.description: A prefix that ends with a slash covers a folder; any other prefix names one file.

host_placed_paths.description: Files or folders the host wrote into the workspace for this step. The path checks ignore them.

evidence_dir.description: Where the checks script writes one evidence file and one diff file per run, for example .baltor/step-output/evidence.

commit_message_style.description: The project's commit message convention in plain words, with one example subject.

allow_commits_since_base.description: false: HEAD must still be the base revision. true: commits since the base are allowed, but the base must remain an ancestor of HEAD.

command.description: The program and its arguments, run without a shell from the workspace root.

output_path.description: A path inside .baltor/ and outside .baltor/step/, the packet folder that the step only reads.
